best_idea: Award kill XP per attacker as the kill's XP budget times that attacker's share of total damage, computed once on the server at the death event, so a many-on-one fight splits the reward by work done.
decision_why: Take the per-attacker credit-share award for the up-to-three attackers; leave the fellowship level-band split and distance scalar until Frankendom has a party system.
acceptance: A server test with a 100-XP kill and three attackers with credit 50/30/20 awards 50, 30, 20 XP (before the modifier), and after a heal of half the missing health every attacker's credit halves while the three XP shares stay 50/30/20.
